what: 47 Tucanae on the HAYDN baseline: medians per 0.3 mag bin in the PLATO P band (the magnitude the HAYDN Noise Estimator works in; about 0.23 mag brighter than Gaia G for these stars, median, 90 per cent range 0.22 to 0.28) of the noise-estimator output, from 10.0 to 18.4 mag. Per bin: star count, median total noise-to-signal ratio, the median photon, detector, target-jitter and crowding terms, and the median stellar pollution ratio. Noise terms in ppm per square root of an hour.
source: HAYDNsim run output for 47 Tuc (runs/47tuc/outputs/47tuc_mag185_hne.npz, 91,350 stars), binned by the HAYDNsim maintainer on 2026-10-26
same_as: The bins and term groups of the 47 Tuc panel on the TASC10/KASC17 poster, Neitzel et al. 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23263454 (CC BY 4.0)
status: The per-star table is private. These binned medians are the values already shown on the public poster.
copied: 2026-10-26, unchanged; second copy after the band correction
band_note: The public poster's 47 Tucanae panel labels this axis as Gaia G; the axis is the P band. Corrected by the HAYDNsim maintainer on 2026-10-26.
